question: A boy focusses a sharp image of a distant object on a screen using a lens. The distance between the lens and screen is approximately equal to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**f**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When a boy focuses a sharp image of a distant object using a lens, the distance between the lens and the screen is approximately equal to the **focal length (f)** of the lens.
